note: A binds the table values more faithfully: its Astigmatism and Tip-tilt entries land in the correct charge/column cells and it correctly states the HLC as the backup coronagraph, whereas B misreads 0.0049/0.0064 as 0.049/0.064, binds them to charge 6, and assigns the HLC's TRL 5 to the VVC. Both sets garble the table condition ("2e-11 raw starlight suppression" rendered as "11-star raw stripe/straight suppression") and mishandle the 1 mas stellar-size column (A drops it where needed, B adds it to the non-1 mas block). A's own errors are two right-block column misassignments (Defocus 4.6 nm and Tip-tilt 31 nm) plus a garbled "optimal trading-angle" attribute, and it pads with heading/figure fragments and a repeated two-plane label. On balance A has more correct, well-bound claims and its errors are column slips rather than values that do not exist in the source.
remarks: Table 5.5-6 has two blocks: 'Allowable RMS Wavefront Error (nm) per Mode' (charges 4/6/8/10, no 1 mas) and 'Allowable RMS Error (nm) per Mode' (charges 6/8/10, with 1 mas stellar size). Both extractions garble the caption condition '2e-11 raw starlight suppression (at 2.5-3.5 lambda/D)' and neither keeps the two blocks cleanly separated: A misassigns right-block values to the wrong charge and omits the 1 mas condition, B attaches '1 mas stellar size' to left-block values. B also splits the single 'focal plane mask can be either an HLC or a VVC' fact into three claims, and A fragments the Figure 5.5-16 optical path into four claims plus repeats the 'two-plane' label; the TRL 5 / HLC-backup sentence is a recurring misbinding target.
